description: Alt Mobility is a full-stack electric fleet leasing platform that drives rapid EV adoption through asset management. With a fleet of 20,000 vehicles across 30 Indian cities leased to fleet operators and drivers, the company offers a comprehensive solution including leasing, servicing, charging, real-time fleet monitoring, and data-driven insights to ensure low total cost of ownership and maximum fleet uptime.

Ampersand is East Africa's leading electric mobility company, building and financing electric motorcycles and battery-swapping infrastructure to accelerate the transition to clean, affordable transportation. The company helps commercial riders increase earnings while reducing operating costs and carbon emissions.

BimaKavach is India's first AI-native commercial insurance platform, built on the belief that underwriting commercial risk at scale requires artificial intelligence at the core of every decision, supported by deep human expertise. Operating across direct, field, and embedded distribution channels, the company combines underwriting expertise from leading Indian insurers with a proprietary risk intelligence layer that ensures coverage is honestly priced, structured to actual risk, and built to hold at the point of claim. BimaKavach serves more than 5,000 businesses across 2,400+ pincodes, covering liability, cyber, fire, engineering, and more.

CarePoint (formerly Africa Health Holdings) is a tech-forward healthcare owner and operator that is dedicated to building a dependable and sustainable healthcare ecosystem in Africa. The company operates a chain of healthcare businesses across its three geographies of operation and offers a hybrid delivery model with in-person services supplemented by telemedicine, enabling individuals to receive access to high-quality medical care.

Cinch is a land management company creating a new supply of productive agricultural land across Africa. By aggregating and leasing underutilized land from smallholder landowners, Cinch optimizes land use and develops scalable farming operations that supply agricultural commodities through long-term offtake partnerships, improving land productivity, farmer incomes, and food system resilience.

Clinikk is a healthcare company focused on delivering comprehensive & quality primary healthcare solutions and affordable & accessible insurance plans with an online & offline model for the aspirational Indian consumer class.

Eden Care is a health technology company transforming healthcare access through digital insurance administration and healthcare financing solutions. Its platform enables employers, insurers, and healthcare providers to deliver seamless, data-driven health benefits while improving patient experiences and health outcomes across Africa.

Fasal offers a full stack platform for horticulture crops which collects microclimatic data using on-field sensors and offers real-time farm information. Its AI and IoT-based device uses integrated sensors to monitor a range of climatic and soil parameters, providing farmers with precise recommendations for disease and pest management, irrigation, and farm planning.

description: FreshR is a B2B agritech platform for the fish and meat industry. The company’s goal is to organize the $50 billion domestic market by being a one-stop shop for distributors, HORECA, exporters and institutional buyers, powered by our digital ordering & tracking platform. They cater to bulk orders across India, with products ranging from fresh and frozen chicken, mutton, fish and seafood, as well as imported products. With a fully-integrated farm-to-factory operation, they provide top quality, fully traceable, hygienically packed & processed products, at the doorstep of their clients.

Frontier Markets is a last mile distribution platform with a mission to create 'Saral Jeevan' or an 'Easy Life' for rural households in last mile villages by providing them local access to high quality, climate friendly, and gender inclusive products and services, including clean energy services, by investing in rural women entrepreneurs as the connector to rural communities.

Kasha Global, Inc. brings the power of FemTech to mass market retail in Africa through a centralized digital platform for the sale and last mile distribution of quality affordable health and personal care products. Kasha sells health, hygiene and pharma products in bulk and direct to consumer, delivering to the last mile through Kasha Agents in low income and rural communities. Kasha’s digital and last mile platform democratizes access to women's health.

Lal10 is India’s largest aggregator of textile factories for cloud-based export operation. Lal10 enables creative manufacturing micro small and medium sized enterprises (MSMEs) to easily digitize, manage and sell their inventories for cross border wholesale.

Lapaire is a Pan-african eye-wear brand with the goal of making eye care more accessible and affordable in Africa. It now operates 134 stores across 10 countries and beyond selling eyewear at fair and transparent prices, Lapaire also provides memorable and expert customer service and proximity to its customers.
location: Cote d'Ivoire (HQ), Burkina Faso, Mali, Benin, Togo, Uganda

description: Viebeg is a healthtech company in Eastern and Central Africa that is disrupting the medical supply industry with service and technology. Viebeg’s data-driven logistics platform — incl. shipping, warehousing, last-mile distribution, and inventory management — empowers healthcare facilities to better manage procurement, ensuring they have the right medical supplies in stock to properly treat patients. Viebeg utilizes AI to de-risk and optimize the supply chain in traditionally hard-to-serve markets.

XENO is a goal-based investment platform that helps millions in Africa to plan, save, and invest for any financial goal from as little as $3 via web, app, or USSD. XENO democratizes access to professional investment management, helping users come up with a plan to save and invest earnings to smartly accomplish a financial goal. The innovative platform allows users to save with or without access to the internet.

Zanifu is a financial platform for MSMEs (Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises) that struggle to access financing due to limited collateral, their size, and the absence of formal credit history. By providing a platform for small retailers to procure inventory from suppliers and pay later, Zanifu unlocks the immense potential of the $45 billion MSME financing market in Kenya, Uganda, and Tanzania.
